title: Publications (Volume I and Summary Results of Factory Sector) of Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) 2024-25 (Survey period: October 2025 to June 2026) November, 2026
subtitle:
Manufacturing Corporate sector registered GVA growth of 9.28 % over previous year
Net Value Added per Factory in Operation witnessed increase by 6.59 % over previous year
GVA per Person Engaged grew by 2.25 % over previous year
body_text: Snapshot: Registered manufacturing sector has recorded notable growth in respect of Gross Value of Plant & Machinery by 7.25 % in the year 2024-25 over the previous year. During the same period, the Manufacturing Corporate sector having share of more than 89% in total GVA has reported growth in number of factories in operation and total persons engaged by 3.45 % and 7.57 %, respectively. The top five industries, Food Products, Textiles, Basic metals, Motor Vehicles, and Wearing Apparel taken together, have contributed more than 41% of the total manufacturing employment of the country during 2024-25. Maharashtra, Gujarat, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Uttar Pradesh have emerged to be the top 5 States in respect of GVA having share of more than 54% of the total manufacturing GVA of the country in 2024-25. The detailed publications of ASI 2024-25, viz. Volume I and Summary Results of Factory Sector along with Unit level data of ASI 2024-25 and metadata are now disseminated. Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) has released the results of Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) for the reference period April 2024 to March 2025 (i.e. financial year 2024-25) through the factsheet on 30 th September 2026.  The factsheet along with some special tables generated based on ASI 2024-25 data are available in the website of the Ministry ( https://www.mospi.gov.in ). The detailed publications of ASI 2024-25, viz. Volume I and Summary Results of Factory Sector along with unit level data are now available for dissemination. A brief note about the survey ASI 2024-25 is given at the Endnote. Annual Survey of Industries is conducted with the primary objective to provide a meaningful insight into the dynamics of change in the composition, growth and structure of various manufacturing industries in terms of output, value added, employment, capital formation and a host of other parameters. It provides valuable input to the National Accounts Statistics at national and state level. The results are prepared at state and major industry level. Annual Survey of Industries: Volume-I publication contains detailed results of factory sector. This publication presents data relating to capital, employment, emoluments and several other economic parameters relevant to industrial sector such as (i) number of factories, (ii) fixed/working capital, (iii) total input, (iv) total output, (v) depreciation, (vi) gross value added, (vii) employment details, (viii) fuels consumption details, etc. The results are released at 2/3/4- digit industry-code wise [National Industrial Classification (NIC), 2008] for all-India and at 2/3-digit level of NIC-2008 for States/UTs. In addition to Volume I, Summary Results for Factory Sector is prepared based on ASI 2024-25 results with the objective to draw attention to certain key features of the ASI results. The Summary Results for Factory Sector aims to present a comprehensive overview of the ASI findings through specialized tables highlighting key characteristics such as employment size, capital investment, gross output and net value added at both the national and State/UT levels. These tables provide an extensive summary of the industrial landscape at the regional as well as at the national level. These two publications: Volume I and Summary Results of Factory Sector, along with Unit level data of ASI 2024-25 are uploaded on the website of the Ministry ( www.mospi.gov.in ). ASI 2024-25: Data highlights During FY2024-25, the registered manufacturing industry experienced notable expansion, driven by upward trends across key economic metrics—including capital investment, production output, Gross Value Added (GVA), workforce numbers, and compensation in comparison to the prior year. Assessment of ASI 2024-25 data by investment size Table 1 gives the percentage distribution of factories by size of capital, namely, the gross value of plant and machinery installed in the factory and their shares in certain selected characteristics. It shows that the factories with an investment in plant and machinery up to ₹ 5 Crores, account for 78.69% of the total factories which have operated during 2024-25. While these factories share 10.55% of total fixed capital, their share in total persons engaged is 34.32%. Their contribution to the total output and net value added are 19.24% and 17.61%, respectively. As against this, the share of operational factories, with gross investment in plant and machinery of ₹ 10 Crores & above, is 15.84%, account for 87.42% of total fixed capital, 59.66% of total persons engaged, 76.82% of the gross output and 78.07% of the total net value added. Units with 100 or more employees registered in the Business Register of Establishments (BRE) prepared and maintained by the State Governments as and when such lists are shared by the respective State Governments. ASI frame and its updation The ASI frame is based on the lists of registered factory / units maintained by the Chief Inspector of Factories (CIF) in each State and those maintained by registration authorities in respect of Bidi and Cigar establishments and electricity undertakings. The frame is being revised and updated periodically by the Regional Offices of the Field Operations Division of NSO in consultation with the Chief Inspector of Factories in the State. At the time of revision, the names of the de-registered factories are removed from the ASI frame and those of the newly registered factories are added. For the units selected in the last survey year (in this case 2023-24), relevant fields like Status Code, Frame industry (NIC 4 digit), Employee (Total persons engaged), Address etc. of frame for a given year, say, ASI 2024-25 are auto-updated dynamically based on the information collected during the last survey year. Unit of Enumeration The primary unit of enumeration in the survey is a factory in the case of manufacturing industries, a workshop in the case of repair services, an undertaking or a licensee in the case of electricity, gas & water supply undertakings and an establishment in the case of bidi & cigar industries. The owner of two or more establishments located in the same State and pertaining to the same industry group and belonging to census scheme is, however, permitted to furnish a single consolidated return. Such consolidated returns are common feature in the case of bidi and cigar establishments, electricity and certain public sector undertakings. Data Collection Mechanism Data for ASI are collected from the selected factories under the Collection of Statistics Act 2008 as amended in 2017 and Rules framed there under in 2011. The entire survey is conducted through a dedicated web-portal without any paper schedule. For data collection in ASI, an establishment (and not enterprise) approach is followed wherein data are collected from the selected establishments.
